headline: Wardens Broaden Hold in Weathered Expanse and Stonecradle as Fronts Flare
war_summary: Since our last edition the Wardens have bettered their position at the war's two hardest-contested crossings. The Weathered Expanse now stands six bases Warden against three Colonial, where five and four stood when we last wrote; thirty actions mark its past day, seven inside the final two hours, the last logged as this dispatch was filed, with Crow's Nest and Frostmarch the storm centers. Stonecradle shifted likewise, four Warden to five Colonial, Buckler Sound its busiest point, the region's combined day toll above twenty-six thousand even as hourly losses cool. Mooring County, held ten to two, reported fresh events within two hours about The Cut and The Wind Hills, its losses climbing anew. Farranac Coast remains unsettled near Transient Valley, and in the Linn of Mercy, all eleven bases under Colonial colors, casualty rates accelerate sharply where Lathair logged nine actions. The Nevish Line's storm and the Dead Lands have gone quiet, as have Fisherman's Row and the Gutter, while Stlican Shelf, base-silent since morning, bleeds at rising rates. It is the 347th day of the war; no victor is declared and thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
